controlReference.method: OSM native control/start nodes; FIA turn positions transferred to the geographic line; S1 = T5 + 90 m, S2 = T12 + 140 m, speed trap = T14 - 140 m

limitations: NAIP acquired 11 June 2022 precedes completed Sphere and Grand Prix Plaza; current OSM footprints and separately reconstructed structures replace these objects.
FIA sporting controls and 43 garage bays use the latest available 2025 document; 2026 FIA event notes are not yet available.
Grandstand footprints and dimensions are reconstructions from 2026 promoter location maps, not surveyed event polygons.

No public LoD2/DSM was acquired. OSM height/levels provide building elevations; untagged objects use a disclosed 6.2 m estimate. Facade modules are authored textures tinted from OSM colour tags and visual references.
Width is nominal 12 m; temporary kerbs, barriers, hospitality structures and event-specific resurfacing are photo/map reconstructions.

Sphere shows the official F1 logo on an authored red LED display at the user’s request; this artwork is not claimed as a verified 2026 event screen. Small service vehicles, containers and unlocated 2026 motorhomes are omitted.

The former Mirage/Hard Rock resort is being renovated for 2027. Its retained tower uses the historical bronze facade estimate. Guitar Tower uses its OSM footprint and Clark County approved 542/660 ft heights; waisted silhouette and blue glazing are approximate construction-era reconstructions.

Night lighting is an authored reconstruction: room occupancy, fixture distribution and brightness are approximate, not measured event photometry. Native footprints, road geometry and source colours are retained.

Driving axes are locally rounded from the pinned OSM polygonal guide in native metres; apex radii are reconstructed, not surveyed. Main sigma 3 m, locally 10.5 m at sharp vertices; pit sigma 6 m. Source-reference distances are remapped to the rounded axis; no global scaling.
